spinner.fix: Skeleton shaped like the area; a spinner only beside a button, field or status text ("Saving…")

disabledButton.fix: A disabled button can't take focus, so its reason (title) is unreachable from the keyboard. Prefer aria-disabled plus a visible hint, or hide the action when it never applies

ariaOnlyLabel.fix: When text naming the field is on screen, tie it with <label for> (or wrap the field in <label>). aria-label alone is fine only where no label is shown on purpose: a search box in a toolbar, an inline rename

iconOnlyButtonNoName.fix: An icon-only button needs aria-label (title alone is not announced reliably)

hardColour.fix: Use var(--panel), var(--text), var(--accent)… from src/editor/theme.ts so Settings > Appearance themes it

areYouSure.fix: Title = question with the object, text = consequence with count and names; prefer undo over asking

notes: Patterns are PCRE2 and may span lines (JSX attributes): search with ripgrep --pcre2 --multiline. Counts are hits per file; ui-ux-baseline.json holds the ratchet (check -> file -> count). The design boards for ADR 0417 were audited with the same checks on 2026-11-25 (HTML, outside the repo).
